scope: Official documentation research; no GPU, install, credentials, browser UI or algorithm changes

capabilities.torch_cuda_activity: Observed successful in prior recorded H200 run, not a hardware-counter permission test
capabilities.ncu_nsys_installed: Not established by documentation; local/image audit owns this fact
capabilities.exact_cta_sm_start_end_trace: Not provided by ordinary CUPTI kernel activity record; unestablished under existing tool-only constraint
capabilities.sampled_tail: Conditional NCU PM Sampling, supported metric query and permission needed; aggregate not exact CTA trace
capabilities.warp_stalls: Conditional NCU/CUPTI PC sampling, no time resolution for individual samples in documented path

version_policy: Current docs describe features that installed tool versions may lack. Record --version and help, gate every optional flag/metric/section on installed support. No auto-install or permission escalation.

future_ncu_policy.worker_status: Template only; no worker implemented or run in this preparation turn
future_ncu_policy.determinism: Fresh state and identical filtered kernel name/grid/block/order across application passes
future_ncu_policy.mutable_state: Application reruns reinitialize caches and tickets; no blind individual-kernel replay assumption
future_ncu_policy.stop: Missing option, kernel mismatch, nonzero target exit, permission error or deadline
caveats: Whole application setup repeats per pass and must remain within cost/watchdog bound
Cache history and actual physical clocks still vary; profile durations are not benchmark latency
PM sampling is aggregate, not exact CTA-to-SM tracing
